title: C/Zephyr: SCHC decompression consecutive-failure tracker absent
description: spec/03-adaptation.md 5.7: 'Production decompression ingress MUST maintain a bounded consecutive-failure tracker keyed by the authenticated link signer ... When the tracker is full, an ingress MUST fail closed for a previously untracked signer and MUST NOT evict an existing run.' Classification: not-implemented in C. Evidence: no tracker anywhere in lichen/subsys (rg clean); Rust rust/lichen-schc/src/context.rs:43-108 RuleVersionFailureTracker + lichen-node/src/stack.rs:224-345 (threshold 3, no-eviction fail-closed); Python python/src/lichen/schc/context.py:214-265 + node.py:1318-1343. Vectors rule_versioning.json failure_tracker_capacity consumed by Rust+Python only. Suggested placement: lichen/subsys/lichen/schc or the L2 RX path. Filed from spec-coverage sweep 2026-08-31 (R-03-068/069).
